positive_rule: direct activity, molecular interaction, or host phenotype contribution under a cold-related condition with mapped sequence and evidence anchor
negative_rule: same endpoint and condition has explicit no-effect/no-activity evidence; absence of annotation or another endpoint negative is not enough
unknown_rule: missing, not significant, unreported, construct unresolved, non-comparable condition, or source context without a target assay
exclude_rule: general cold-source metadata, expression association, or cell-application outcomes cannot replace a direct cold-related protein property
strict_requirements: primary evidence, exact sequence/construct, comparable condition, credible positive or scoped negative, split-safe component and license gate reviewed
evaluation_use: small challenge or positive-unlabeled retrieval unless strict positives and negatives independently scale

positive_rule: direct protein/gene contribution to survival or macromolecule protection in a defined drying/rehydration assay
negative_rule: matched protein/gene or construct tested in the same defined assay with scoped lack of protection or sensitivity
unknown_rule: quantitative context without target threshold, repository scale without direct labels, or source phenotype not tied to a sequence
exclude_rule: general intrinsically disordered status or transcriptome presence alone is auxiliary, not a task label
strict_requirements: mapped sequence, primary assay, condition and control resolved, and component-aware split support
evaluation_use: current small challenge; formal binary blocked by scale and independent split support

positive_rule: screen or follow-up evidence that sequence/gene contributes under a specified oxidative condition, or purified detoxification assay
negative_rule: explicit matched negative under same condition and endpoint; non-significant screen endpoints remain unknown
unknown_rule: not significant, missing, expression-only, ambiguous direction, or no sequence mapping
exclude_rule: renaming an oxidative source label or RA source alias does not create a target label
strict_requirements: independent positive and credible negative evidence with mapped sequence and no target leakage

prediction_object: protein_sequence_with defined perchlorate/chlorate pathway or condition evidence
positive_rule: genetic or biochemical evidence for pathway function or condition contribution with mapped sequence
negative_rule: explicit matched loss/no-effect evidence under comparable condition; background genes are unknown
unknown_rule: direction not resolved, nonnegative workbook value without sign semantics, unmapped locus, or context-only measurement
exclude_rule: general pathway membership or condition annotation alone is not sufficient for a scoped label
strict_requirements: direction semantics, target scope, sequence mapping and independent negative evidence resolved
evaluation_use: positive-unlabeled retrieval draft until target-direction and negative gaps close

prediction_object: protein_sequence_with radiation-condition survival or DNA-protection evidence
positive_rule: mapped sequence has direct DNA protection or host survival contribution under specified radiation condition
negative_rule: explicit matched negative under the same condition; source count gaps or context rows are not negatives
unknown_rule: condition mismatch, missing endpoint, source count inconsistency, expression-only, or unresolved mapping
exclude_rule: RA001/RA005 contextual rows cannot be used as negatives without target-level assay support
strict_requirements: primary evidence, condition resolved, exact sequence/construct, credible positive/negative and split support
evaluation_use: positive-unlabeled retrieval draft; no formal binary release

prediction_object: protein_sequence_with defined high-salt activity, stability, or host contribution evidence
positive_rule: direct activity/stability/host contribution under a predefined high-salt condition and mapped sequence
negative_rule: matched tested sequence or construct with scoped loss/no retention under the same condition
unknown_rule: no threshold, expression-only, environmental source only, condition mismatch, or mapping unresolved
exclude_rule: halophilic source annotation alone does not label a protein as salt-adapted
strict_requirements: condition, construct, sequence and split support resolved; independent positive/negative support reviewed
evaluation_use: current small challenge; scale and independent components still limit formal release
